name: Aging and Disability Resource Center, Belknap County
organization: Aging and Disability Resource Center, Belknap County
description: The county’s Aging and Disability Resource Center (formerly ServiceLink): free, confidential help for older adults, adults with disabilities and caregivers to find services at home, plan long-term care and get Medicare counseling. There are no financial eligibility requirements.
next_step: Call and describe what is hard right now. Ask for information and assistance. You can also call the statewide line, 866-634-9412, and ask for your local center. Military service is not required.
constraints: Many services focus on people age 60 and older and adults with disabilities; eligibility and waitlists vary by program.
Office: 67 Water St., Laconia.

name: NH Office of the Long-Term Care Ombudsman
organization: NH Office of the Long-Term Care Ombudsman
description: The regional long-term care ombudsman for this county: advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and residential care facilities.
next_step: Call the regional ombudsman program. Give the facility name and county. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.

source_evidence.title: NH Department of Health and Human Services: Adult Abuse
source_evidence.scope: For nursing or assisted living facilities, contact the Long Term Care Ombudsman at (800) 442-5640 or (603) 271-4375; read in full. The office is statewide, so every county shows it.

source_evidence.title: NH Code of Administrative Rules, Chapter Omb 400: Office of the Long-Term Care Ombudsman
